corroboration: Sign-flipped published_ds in docs/GENMOL_T4_SEEDS.json; the QED and SA components of the same prefix were independently verified against every seed SMILES.
sign_convention: docking score, more negative is better; improvement over seed = result - seed, negative means improved
source: First component of each published row's DS/QED/SA prefix, i.e. the starting molecule's own docking score.
usage: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Never substitute a seed for a generated candidate and never use seed-relative improvement to manufacture a score. The official protocol governs what enters the reported pool.
why_separate_file: Kept out of t4_published_invirtuogen_baseline.json because four live delta=0.4 contracts pin that file by physical sha256 in reported_ivg_source.artifact_sha256. Editing it moves the hash and fails tools/verify_t4_d04_panel.py while those campaigns are running.
